title: Recovery Flarecards — Quickstart error visuals for rate limits, timeouts, and retry flow
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Create a compact set of visual assets ("flarecards") and annotated screenshots for the Quickstart and Troubleshooting docs that clearly communicate rate limit, request timeout, and retry behavior. These flarecards are small, horizontally-oriented illustrated cards designed to appear inline in the Quickstart, in contextual help in the Console, and in the public Docs error-handling guide. Scope: art direction, three illustrated situations (rate-limit backoff, outgoing request timeout, client-triggered retry with jitter), animated retry hint (subtle loop animation), annotated Console screenshots (desktop + mobile), microcopy variants for primary/secondary CTA, localization-ready text tokens, alt-text and accessibility pass. Deliver a figma file with dedicated frames for docs, console components (callout banners and inline cards), and an assets export sheet (SVG optimized + 1x/2x PNG + webm animation). Include engineering handoff notes for CSS classes, CSS token names, and suggested ARIA attributes for screen-reader announcements.

Primary goals: 1) reduce onboarding confusion when users hit soft rate limits or timeouts during initial API testing; 2) give clear next steps (wait, reduce stream frequency, enable retry with exponential backoff); 3) provide assets that are visually distinct from other support content (avoid generic red error blocks) while remaining accessible and brand-consistent.

Intended placements: Quickstart popover cards, Console request log inline help, Docs troubleshooting guide (Rate limits / Timeouts / Retries), email runbook snippets for SREs.

Notes on uniqueness: use "flarecards" motif — a compact card with small illustrative ribbon/flare on the left to differentiate category (rate limit = amber flare, timeout = blue flare, retry = green flare). Card variants: short (one-line microcopy + icon), expanded (2–3 lines explanatory + CTA), interactive demo frame for docs (shows retry count animation).
design_notes: Design decisions and trade-offs: choose compact horizontal cards to avoid pushing down the Quickstart flow; prioritize calm colors (amber/blue/green) instead of high-contrast reds to reduce user anxiety during onboarding. Use a single-line icon + short headline for the compact variant; expanded variant includes a one-step suggestion, a code snippet link to exponential backoff helper, and a small 'Try again' button. Accessibility trade-offs: animations must be reduced-motion aware and provide non-animated fallback screenshots. Localization: allow up to 120 characters on the expanded copy; keep primary CTA separate so translators can avoid concatenation issues. Engineering constraints: prefer inline SVGs for crispness and CSS variables for colors so console theme-switching works. If kernel-level runtime errors are surfaced, guidance should fall back to a link to SRE runbook rather than showing internal error codes in public docs.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file delivered with frames for compact/expanded/interactive variants and export-ready asset sheet
SVGs and PNGs exported and uploaded to assets folder
Animated retry hint exported as webm + Lottie JSON (if feasible) and reduced-motion variant provided
Annotated desktop and mobile Console screenshots exported with callouts and copy tokens
Handoff doc describing CSS token names, ARIA attributes, and localization token keys added to Confluence and linked in ticket
PM and Eng sign-off on copy and placement in Quickstart popover
